inbound_websocket_events.description: Emitted by KnowledgeChatOrchestrator for autonomous video generation progress, revisions, and deliverable handoffs.

payload.state: enum (PLANNING | RETRIEVING_KNOWLEDGE | COMPOSING | VALIDATING | RENDERING | VIDEO_VERIFIED | REVIEW_READY | BLOCKED_RIGHTS | PENDING_CREDENTIALS | FAILED_TERMINAL)
payload.deliverable_url: string | null (relative or absolute URL to rendered MP4)

inbound_websocket_events.frontend_handling: Maps in-flight states to activeJobs store; transitions to Review mode and loads project/video when deliverable_url or REVIEW_READY is present; fails activeJob truthfully on blockers.
Updates appStore.wsConnected; informs user of offline or reconnecting status.
Starts tracking activeJob with authentic step text.
Updates activeJob without synthetic percentage inflation.
Marks activeJob as completed, updates UI.
Marks activeJob as failed and displays error message in chat.

inbound_websocket_events.description: Broadcasts that a project's document has advanced to a new revision.
inbound_websocket_events.frontend_handling: Updates project revision and scene graph if no unsaved local dirty state exists.

outbound_websocket_events.description: User natural language request or chat revision sent to planner/orchestrator.
Binds active WebSocket connection to specific chat session.

compatibility_assumptions_for_agent_5.router_routes: Agent 5 keeps primary routes: /motion (default), /trends, /channels, /videos, /messaging, /settings. Legacy routes (/catalog, /clips, /tools) redirect to /motion.
compatibility_assumptions_for_agent_5.database_safety: Agent 2 made zero database schema changes or migrations; uses existing Project and GeneratedVideo schemas.
compatibility_assumptions_for_agent_5.backend_dependencies: Agent 2 frontend expects backend to serve GET /api/projects/{id}, POST /api/projects, GET /api/projects/{id}/preview, GET /api/videos/{id}/stream, and WebSocket /ws/chat.
compatibility_assumptions_for_agent_5.joint_e2e_integration: Joint multi-agent E2E tests (Edge driving full stack with actual LLM generation and FFmpeg render) must be re-run on Agent 5 merged candidate branch.

feature_matrix.title: Five Primary Sidebar Destinations & Mandatory Order
feature_matrix.details: Strict order verified: Motion Graphics (/motion), Trends (/trends), My Channel (/channels), Library (/videos), Messages (/messaging). Settings secondary at bottom.

feature_matrix.title: Create and Review Stages Only (Refine Eliminated)
feature_matrix.details: Stage switcher strictly provides Create and Review. The SaaS Refine tab is eliminated from the primary workflow.

feature_matrix.title: Unobtrusive Advanced Editing Disclosure
feature_matrix.details: Subdued Advanced Editing button in toolbar and stage header exposes lower timeline and layers without becoming a third primary navigation mode.

feature_matrix.title: Complete Elimination of User-Facing Catalog Cards & Block Pickers
feature_matrix.details: Zero 196 catalog cards, hover previews, or Add Block buttons in active code paths. StudioResourcePanel contains only real Media Assets and Trend Sources.

feature_matrix.title: Zero Phantom Project on Empty State
feature_matrix.details: Opening /motion without a project query parameter lands in clean NO_PROJECT state and triggers zero POST /api/projects calls.

feature_matrix.title: Legacy Routes Clean Redirection Without Template Shopping
feature_matrix.details: Legacy routes (/catalog, /clips, /tools) redirect cleanly to /motion without shopping query params.

feature_matrix.title: Typed Native Motion Adapter & Content-Safe Drop Boundaries
feature_matrix.details: Full typed adapter for native_motion_v1 supporting composition operators, scenes, elements, and captions. Strict boundary rejection for illegal cross-category drops.

feature_matrix.title: Authentic Job State & Zero Fake Percentages
feature_matrix.details: Job status pill consumes activeJob.step || activeJob.message || 'composing'; zero fabricated progress percentages.

feature_matrix.title: Review Panel Integrity & Truthful Social Publishing Blocker
feature_matrix.details: Displays authentic deliverables count, chat correction guidance, editorial approval toggle, and NOT_CONNECTED / PENDING_CREDENTIALS notice confirming editorial approval is not an uploaded post.

feature_matrix.title: Professional Timed Captions Overlay & Typography
feature_matrix.details: Professional caption overlay tracking currentTime with word-level highlighting (#facc15), high contrast backdrop, non-obscuring lower third placement, and accessibility polite live region.

feature_matrix.title: Real WebSocket OAAS Outcome and Connection State Handling
feature_matrix.details: Subscribes to _connection_state, oaas_outcome_update, and project_created. Auto-attaches empty state to project, updates revision, and transitions to Review mode on deliverable ready.

feature_matrix.title: Responsive Viewport Verification in Microsoft Edge
Joint Full-Stack End-to-End Chat-to-Render-to-Review Lifecycle
feature_matrix.details: Full stack integration requires running merged candidate stack (backend Agent 1 + Agent 3 + Agent 4 + Agent 2 frontend + Agent 5 integrator). Isolated worktree contract fully verified.
